build_voc_dataset: build a VOCDetection dataset for a given image set with transforms applied
create_voc_transforms: create VOC image transforms for train or val sets with optional difficult removal
test_voc_getitem: test the VOCDetection __getitem__ method to return an image and target tuple
review_voc_coco_format: review the VOCDetection get_in_coco_format method to return COCO-formatted image and target
refactor_voc_transforms: refactor make_voc_transforms to customize resize sizes or normalization parameters
